assertions.text: The document gives a definite answer on the Northbank offer (accept, decline, or accept on stated conditions) as its own recommendation, rather than leaving the decision to Danny.
assertions.evidence: "**The call: decline Northbank and go independent in September — conditional on a signed SOW from Halyard by end of day Thursday 13 August.** If it isn't signed by then, sign Northbank on the 14th." Stated as the author's own call, with both branches specified.

assertions.text: Nothing the document asks Danny to do before deciding extends past the August 14 offer deadline; any pre-decision steps fit inside the time remaining.
assertions.evidence: Every pre-decision step lands before the 14th: "3 Aug (tomorrow): text Priya 'go'"; "By 6 Aug: apply for own-occupation disability insurance"; "Email Grace, this week"; "13 Aug (Thursday): the gate." Deadline slack is stated: "you have eleven days."

assertions.text: The document treats only about C$112,000 of the C$312,400 portfolio as spendable runway, because C$200,000 is committed to the 2028 house down payment under his and Sofia's written agreement.
assertions.evidence: LIFE_PATHS.md: "C$200,000 untouchable, hard... Free capital after the house line: **C$112,400.**" finances.md models FI "starting from C$112,400 (portfolio minus the house money)"; sweep.py: ASSETS = 112_400 "portfolio minus the untouchable C$200k house money".

assertions.text: The document cites Relay's specific figures (41 customers, or about US$780 a month of revenue) rather than describing its traction only in qualitative terms.
assertions.evidence: dossier.md: "41 customers at US$19, US$779 MRR, launched June 2025." evidence.md E12: "41 customers × US$19 = US$779 MRR; US$140/mo infra". LIFE_PATHS.md shared action 6: "The bigger move is the existing 41, and here is the arithmetic: at US$49…"

assertions.text: Using Relay's measured growth (9 customers added in six months) or a stated base rate for solo software products, the document assesses whether Relay could replace Danny's employment income, rather than assuming growth.
assertions.evidence: "Calibrated from your own numbers — 32 to 41 customers in six months at 2.5 gross adds a month — churn is 2.73% a month... a steady state of 92 customers, US$1,740 MRR... To replace the Northbank offer's after-tax income takes 658 customers at US$19 — sixteen times the business."

assertions.text: The Halyard contract is weighed as what the record shows: a single unsigned six-month arrangement, not a durable or diversified income stream.
assertions.evidence: "You call Halyard 'the contracting floor.' It isn't a floor. It is one unsigned six-month engagement with one client, where Priya has said in writing that she cannot schedule her own legal team" — plus "The main risk... One client, unsigned, six months... Concentration risk" and Gate 0 conditioning on a signed SOW.

assertions.text: The document names the pattern in Danny's reviews from both employers: strongest during incidents and novel or ambiguous problems, disengaged once work becomes routine maintenance.
assertions.evidence: LIFE_PATHS.md: "Castell, 2018: 'thrives when the problem is on fire or brand new.' Meridian, 2023: 'exceptional in ambiguity.' Meridian, 2025: 'his incident command under pressure is the strongest…'" and "You … disengage when work goes into maintenance mode. The reviews say that too."

assertions.text: The recommended course carries an observable sign, within a stated time window, that it is failing Danny.
assertions.evidence: Path 3 (the recommendation): "**The falsifier.** March 2027... the last six weeks of the Halyard rebuild slip, or Priya doesn't offer a renewal... the price never went up and you made fewer than 20 outbound customer conversations in six months." Plus Gate 1's floor rule (net savings <C$1,000/mo for two months).

assertions.text: No step in the plan requires leaving Toronto before Sofia's training ends in mid-2028.
assertions.evidence: "Binding constraints. Toronto until July 2028, hard." Every path's schedule places relocation at or after that date: Path 1 "**July 2028:** relocation."; Path 3 "**July 2028:** the move." No earlier step requires leaving; Halyard/Meridian/Northbank are all Toronto.

assertions.text: When costing the independent path, the document states a monthly amount Danny personally must cover, computed from the C$7,900 household spend under a stated division between him and Sofia, rather than quoting only the household total.
assertions.evidence: Only household totals appear: "Spend C$7,900/mo. Sofia nets C$4,450/mo" and "To cover just the household's C$7,900/month takes 414." No division of the C$7,900 between Danny and Sofia, and no monthly amount Danny personally must cover ("67% of household take-home" is income share, not a spend split).

assertions.text: The near-term cash arithmetic accounts for the wedding-fund contributions (about C$900 a month through April 2027).
assertions.evidence: finances.md: "Wedding contributions of C$900/mo run Sept 2026–April 2027..." with a surplus table split "during wedding months" vs "after April 2027" — Independent C$1,556 → C$2,456, Northbank C$7,034 → C$7,934 (exactly C$900 apart). Echoed in Path 3 and the chat summary.

assertions.text: The document names mid-2028, when Sofia finishes training and her income rises, as a decision point at which the independence question is deliberately reopened.
assertions.evidence: "**Gate 2 — Monday 1 February 2028.** Before the move... whether Danny's 2028 shape is practice, product, or employment"; Path 1: "**July 2028:** relocation... You re-decide everything here anyway, at 35, with a new mortgage and Sofia starting a practice."

assertions.text: At least one recommended action is concrete enough to complete before August 14: a named message, question, or negotiation point directed at a named party.
assertions.evidence: Shared action 4: "**Text Priya tomorrow.** 'Go' plus the rate ask" — with the negotiation point specified: "ask for **C$120–130/hour**". Also action 2: "**Email Grace, this week.** Two questions... what fraction of the first year is reliability and incident work specifically for this role."

assertions.text: The document analyzes both branches of the fork, the Northbank offer and the independent path, rather than only one of them.
assertions.evidence: Both branches get full sections: "## Path 1 — Take Northbank" with "**The case.** C$185,000 base plus a 15% bonus nets about C$10,921/month…" and "**The case against, which is stronger.**"; plus "## Path 3 — Go independent in September, contracting-led" and "## Path 4 — …Relay-led", each with case, schedule, falsifier, risk.
